Attached: 1 video

hi mastodon! 👋 I made PianoCheetah - a free, open source (MIT) piano/drum practice app for Linux.

remember guitar hero? guitar was fake but fun. drums were real. keyboards... super dumb. so: PianoCheetah.

load any MIDI song, play along on your keyboard, and it waits for you to hit the right notes. notes get squished to 1 per hand so your hands stay put.

bet ya could play it.

get it in KDE Discover / GNOME Software 🎹
https://pianocheetah.app

#introduction #linux #opensource #piano #linuxaudio
